_note: Work in development elsewhere that is not public yet. Nothing here links anywhere: private workspaces are never linked. When an item gets its own public repository, move it to projects.json. tools/check_site.py (L17) checks this file.

items.name: Data portals compass
items.summary: Answer four questions and get a suggested route across the DAM playbooks, the Data Quality Commons, the Repos Asset Catalogue and DCAT-AP-UK, with why each step matters.

items.name: Whole-life 360º
items.summary: Your life with the state, cradle to grave: every role you act in, every life event and every seam where people drop out of sight, across the four nations. It takes in the earlier My 360º prototype.

items.name: Young Person 360º: before the label
items.summary: A young person's own view of the state across the four nations, from birth to adulthood, including the children held, lost or unseen by the system before anyone calls them NEET.

items.name: Earning, learning and training
items.summary: For young people aged 16 to 24: getting into work, learning or training, including starting a business, with the Milburn Review and every UK government strategy, programme, duty and target that bears on it. Adults returning to work or learning are covered by Whole-life 360º.

items.name: Recognition Opportunities Portal
items.summary: Verified award dates, fair ways to recognise people and teams, and tools to send recognition where people work.

items.name: govukOS
items.summary: A multi-app ecosystem concept for public sector work: the HIVE navigator, the govukOS platform and Studio, and SHARE, the data sharing observatory and barometer, which moved into it.
